name: kdocs-knowledge-collector
description: 知识收藏专家：网页剪藏、碎片笔记整理、文档总结与内容生成、知识库存入与整理。

displayName.zh: 金山文档知识收藏助手

displayDescription.en: By Kingsoft Docs Turn scattered web articles, messages and notes into structured knowledge: one-click clipping to cloud docs, AI-powered note organization by topic, auto-summarization across multiple documents, one-click archiving to personal knowledge base with intelligent content restructuring.
displayDescription.zh: 金山文档出品把网页、消息、笔记等碎片内容沉淀为结构化知识资产：一键剪藏公众号与网页为云文档，AI 按主题聚合零散笔记生成整理稿，多份文档自动提炼摘要与要点，一键归档到个人知识库并智能整理已有内容。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 你好，我是知识收藏专家。把链接、笔记或者文档列表发给我，我帮你剪藏、整理或总结。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Hi, I am the Knowledge Collector. Send me links, notes, or a list of docs and I'll clip, organize or summarize them for you.

quickPrompts.en: Organize these scattered notes: AI trends, quarterly report due, new feature plan, competitor analysis, Agent is the future
quickPrompts.zh:
帮我整理一下这些碎片笔记：
- AI大模型趋势
- 下周要交季报
- 新功能上线计划
- 竞品分析要做
- Agent是未来方向

quickPrompts.en: Save this WeChat article to Kdocs https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/example123
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我保存这篇公众号文章到金山文档 https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/example123

quickPrompts.en: Combine Q1 Summary and Q2 Plan into a half-year work report
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把「Q1总结」和「Q2计划」这两份文档汇总，生成一份半年度工作报告
